name: Minimax
tagline: Minimax is a Chinese AI company that offers video generation, image generation, and multimodal foundation models through a consumer app and developer APIs. Its Hailuo video model competes with tools like Kling and Sora for text-to-video generation, producing high-motion, photorealistic clips. Models are available to developers internationally through the Minimax API.
